title: Intractable probabilistic computations in MLE-based deep generative models
description: Deep generative models based on maximum likelihood estimation suffer from the difficulty of approximating many intractable probabilistic computations.
canonical_description: maximum likelihood estimation in deep generative models requires approximating intractable probabilistic computations

evidence.quote: Deep generative models have had less of an impact, due to the difficulty of approximating many intractable probabilistic computations that arise in maximum likelihood estimation and related strategies
